BiblicalUsage: Masrêqâh is Masrekah, a town in Edom named twice, in Genesis 36:36 and 1 Chronicles 1:47. In both places Samlah of Masrekah reigns in Hadad's stead among the kings of Edom. The name is a town that gave a king to a neighbouring nation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Masrêqâh shows me that God records the kings of Edom as well as the kings of Israel, and that no throne is outside His history.
